notes.title: Update 1.0 - Leaving early access
notes.content:
WizardCraft Colonies has today left Early Access and is now available as a full release. It’s been a long journey through Early Access, but it wouldn’t have been possible without our dedicated community who have helped shape what WizardCraft has become and where it will go. With the full release a new update is also available.

Update 1.0 will give the player more control over the villagers and contains the following new features and bug fixes:
[h1][b]
Update 1.0[/b][/h1]

Added more control over the villagers:
-Clicking on a bed while a villager is selected will now instruct it to sleep.
-Clicking on water while a villager is selected will now instruct it to drink.
-Clicking on food while a villager is selected will now instruct it to eat.
-Clicking on a hospital bed while a villager is selected will now instruct it to heal.
-Clicking on a fire while a villager is selected will now instruct it to fire fight.
-Clicking on an enemy while a villager is selected will now instruct it to attack.

[list]
[*] Villagers will now seek out a heat source to warm up when cold, in addition when hot they will seek out a cooler spot to cool down, this can be turned off or on in the AI manager.
[*] The cooling tower has now been changed into an 'air conditioner'. In addition to cooling the surrounding air it will also heat it, keeping the surrounding temperature same as what is set in the thermostat. This will remove the need to have a cooling tower and heater near the same spot.
[*] Bug fixes.
[/list]

tags.feature: -Clicking on a bed while a villager is selected will now instruct it to sleep.
-Clicking on water while a villager is selected will now instruct it to drink.
-Clicking on food while a villager is selected will now instruct it to eat.
-Clicking on a hospital bed while a villager is selected will now instruct it to heal.
-Clicking on a fire while a villager is selected will now instruct it to fire fight.
-Clicking on an enemy while a villager is selected will now instruct it to attack.
Villagers will now seek out a heat source to warm up when cold, in addition when hot they will seek out a cooler spot to cool down, this can be turned off or on in the AI manager.

The cooling tower has now been changed into an 'air conditioner'. In addition to cooling the surrounding air it will also heat it, keeping the surrounding temperature same as what is set in the thermostat. This will remove the need to have a cooling tower and heater near the same spot.

notes.title: Update 0.31 - Haulers
notes.content:
Update 0.31
[list]
[*] Added new unit "Hauler". Haulers will collect and move resources around your base, freeing up the workload of your villagers. Haulers can be rented from travellers and must be paid coin each day. They will work 24/7 and require no additional upkeep.
[*] Dead plants will automatically be destroyed after a while.
[*] Villagers and pet names will now be black when above snow, making them easier to see.
[*] Path lines will now be black in winter, making them easier to see.
[*] Trade requests will no longer just pop up and pause the game, instead a button will appear next to the messages box, clicking on this will open up the trade request.
[*] Added ability to banish babies.
[*] Added ability to set how hungry babies need to be before being fed.
[*] Cows can be milked more often.
[*] Added ability to set owner of a baby cot.
[*] Hedges will now require wood to build, instead of coin.
[*] Added option to manually fill animal feeders and water sources if food or water is available.
[*] Animal feeders will now last for 4 meals instead of one.
[*] Resources on a stockpile will automatically stack themselves over time.
[*] Resources can now be stacked upto 10 instead of 5
[*] Villagers can now carry a stack of upto 10 resources at once, instead of just 1.

[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.25 Bigger world maps.
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added bigger world map. The world map will now currently have 3600 regions with support for bigger world maps. The original world map only had 9 regions.
[*] Each region in the world map will now have a random amount of resources, this will be shown when selecting a new region.
[*] The save files will now consist of a single save file for the world map and multiple save files for each region you set up a base in. This will help to decrease loading times and allow for an unlimited world map size.
[*] Due to changes in the world map, the ability to share resources between regions has been temporarily removed while it is being worked on.
[*] Made improvements to the controls.
[*] When under attack an "under attack!" button will now appear, pressing this will move the camera to where you are being attack from.
[*] When pausing the game all of the villagers paths will now be shown. Allowing the player to easily move them away from any danger.
[*] Fixed some minor bugs.
[/list]

[h1]Important note:[/h1]
Due to the changes on how files are saved in update 0.25 older save files will no longer be compatible and must be deleted. Update 0.25 increases the size of the previous world map of only 9 regions to 3600 regions with support for larger world maps. Changing the way the game is saved has also helped to decrease loading times, and will help us to add more features that we couldn't have with a smaller world map in future updates. 

This will be the only time that save files will become incompatible. So don't worry about any progress being lost in future updates.  We are sorry for any inconvenience this may cause and hope the new features will make up for this.

When under attack an "under attack!" button will now appear, pressing this will move the camera to where you are being attack from.
When pausing the game all of the villagers paths will now be shown. Allowing the player to easily move them away from any danger.

notes.title: Update 0.22 - Factions & Power Towers
notes.content:
[list]

[*] Added new building 'Lightning Power Tower' - Enables the tornado power, an ability to create a tornado storm that will damage nearby enemies.

[*] Monsters will patrol longer distances, spreading them out more.
[*] Added 'Quit' button in the options.
[*] Improved fire.
[*] Added new enemy building 'Bear Cave' - spawns bears over time.
[*] Fixed bug where fish were being spawned in desert regions.
[*] Fixed bug where fires would multiply when loading a game.
[*] Fixed bug where the game would pause for a second the first time a floor was placed.
[/list]
